bundler_and_compiler_interaction.metro_wrapper: __d(function(g, r, i, a, m, e, d) { ... }, moduleId, [depIds])
bundler_and_compiler_interaction.impact_on_static_graphs: Metro passes exports (e) as a callback parameter and resolves dependencies via dynamic array indexing r(d[k]) rather than ESM static imports. Consequently, JAG edges stay intra-module (contains + URL query parameter candidates), while JSRG recovers cross-module contracts via property-slot matching (writes-property <-> reads-property / destructures) accompanied by explicit object-flow ambiguous-target unknowns.

pitchlab_crushes_astra.dimension: Rigor probabilístico y calibración contra cierre sharp
pitchlab_crushes_astra.pitchlab_evidence: Dixon-Coles bivariado con decaimiento temporal exponencial + Elo + regresión logística regularizada + blend logit contra cierre sin margen de Pinnacle/Smarkets (power=38, proportional=16, shin=6 en walk_forward_dev de 56,649 eventos; ECE=0.0025 [0.0017, 0.0056]; paridad TS<->Py < 1e-12 en math.ts/outlook.ts).
pitchlab_crushes_astra.astra_evidence: Ratings ataque/defensa + corrección rho fija por liga (-0.08 en Liga MX, -0.0595 en UEFA) sin de-vigging, sin blend con cierre sharp, sin intervalos bootstrap ni auditoría de calibración ECE/log-loss.
